blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteRbacRolesWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes RBAC roles. When an actor is provided, it validates
that the actor holds every policy of the roles being deleted, so that an
actor cannot delete roles more privileged than themselves.

steps.name: removeRemoteLinkStep
steps.description:
This step deletes linked records of a record if cascade deletion is enabled.

Learn more in the [Link documentation](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/link#cascade-delete-linked-records)

children.name: actor_id
children.description:
The actor deleting the roles. When provided, the actor must hold every
policy of the roles being deleted, mirroring the check applied when
assigning or unassigning them. Omit for trusted system code.
